chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The fasting person and the person in Ihram do not submerge their head in water.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: The person in the state of Ihram (consecration for Hajj/Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on submerging the head in water while fasting or in Ihram?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadi’ (AS) prohibiting the complete submersion of the head in water (*irtimas*) for both the fasting person and the pilgrim in *Ihram*. This prohibition highlights the preservation of ritual distinctiveness and the prevention of excessive immersion that might disrupt the spiritual focus or physical state required for these acts of worship.
